legal_name: Kala Gensets Private Limited (per company website: "KALA Pvt. Ltd. (Genset), formerly known as Kala Genset Pvt. Ltd.") — exact MCA-registered spelling NOT verified
note: Registry data could not be verified: web_search backend was down (searx connection refused) and all registry aggregators (zaubacorp, thecompanycheck) returned HTTP 403; Bing returned only irrelevant results for the query. Only primary source read was the company's own website kalagenset.com, which states it is an authorised Kirloskar Powergen GOEM, designs/manufactures gensets 2–2500 kVA, claims 35 years of operation, six manufacturing facilities and 2 million+ sq ft of own manufacturing — this supports role=manufacturer but is a self-declaration, not a registry record. No CIN, PAN, GSTIN, incorporation date, registered-office state, MCA status or audited revenue figures are public in the sources I could reach, so all are null rather than guessed. Note the name discrepancy: input says 'Kala Genset Pvt Ltd', the site now uses 'Kala Gensets Pvt. Ltd.' (plural) and says it was formerly 'Kala Genset Pvt. Ltd.' — the exact legal entity name, CIN and GSTIN must be confirmed on MCA/GST portal before use. No basis for rejection: no evidence of non-existence, strike-off, liquidation or bankruptcy; the operating website and claimed 35-year history indicate an active business. Declared HS 850211/850212/850213/850220 (diesel/gas generating sets) is consistent with the stated product range, so no HS correction is indicated.
